title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Enterprise Search: A Survey
abstract_note: Survey of RAG pipelines, indexing strategies, evaluation, and deployment tradeoffs in enterprise search.

data.title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Enterprise Search: A Survey

fulltext_text: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) combines dense retrieval with LLM generation. We review chunking, hybrid search, reranking, grounding, and evaluation metrics for enterprise deployments.

title: Full Text PDF
fulltext_text: Abstract—We survey retrieval-augmented generation for enterprise search. Topics include indexing, chunking, hybrid retrieval, reranking, grounding, and offline/online evaluation.

title: RAG survey — deployment notes
note_html: Good checklist: chunk size vs. latency, hybrid retrieval, rerankers, and eval with attribution. Watch for stale index + prompt leakage.

data.annotationText: Evaluate retrieval with nDCG/MRR, but measure answer faithfulness separately.

annotation_json.text: Evaluate retrieval with nDCG/MRR, but measure answer faithfulness separately.

title: Attention Is All You Need
publication_title: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems
abstract_note: Introduces the Transformer architecture using self-attention for sequence transduction.
fulltext_text: We propose the Transformer, a model architecture relying solely on attention mechanisms, dispensing with recurrence and convolutions entirely. Experiments show state-of-the-art results on translation.

title: Transformer paper — key takeaways
note_html: Self-attention enables parallel training; positional encodings needed. Multi-head helps capture different relations. Scales well for language modeling.

title: The Linux Command Line (2nd Edition)
abstract_note: Practical introduction to the shell, scripting, and common Unix tools.

title: Shell scripting reminders
note_html: Prefer set -euo pipefail in CI scripts. Quote variables. Use shellcheck for linting.

title: Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models
abstract_note: Presents diffusion models for high-quality image generation via iterative denoising.
fulltext_text: We define a Markov chain that gradually adds noise to data and learn the reverse process to generate samples. The model yields strong likelihoods and sample quality on images.

title: arXiv PDF
fulltext_text: Denoising diffusion probabilistic models learn the reverse of a fixed noising process. We use a simple parameterization with learned variances and show improved sample quality on CIFAR-10.

data.annotationText: Linear beta schedule works but cosine schedule later improved stability.

annotation_json.text: Linear beta schedule works but cosine schedule later improved stability.

title: PostgreSQL 16 Documentation: JSON Functions and Operators
abstract_note: Reference for JSON/JSONB operators, indexing, and query examples in PostgreSQL 16.

data.title: PostgreSQL 16 Documentation: JSON Functions and Operators

fulltext_text: JSONB operators like ->, ->>, #>, @> and functions such as jsonb_path_query enable flexible document querying. GIN indexes support containment and jsonpath queries for performance.

title: JSONB indexing snippet
note_html: For containment: CREATE INDEX ON items USING gin (metadata_json jsonb_path_ops); Test with @> and @@ jsonpath.

title: GitHub Actions: Contexts
abstract_note: Reference for GitHub Actions context objects (github, env, jobs, steps) and expression syntax.
fulltext_text: Contexts provide information about workflow runs. Use expressions like ${{ github.ref }} and ${{ steps.<id>.outputs.<name> }}. Beware of quoting, booleans, and null behavior in if conditions.

title: Actions expressions gotchas
note_html: if: treats non-empty strings as truthy; prefer explicit comparisons. Use fromJSON() for arrays/maps.

title: OpenAI Python SDK Reference (Responses API)
abstract_note: API reference for creating responses, tool calls, streaming, and error formats.
fulltext_text: Responses API supports multimodal input, tool invocation, and structured outputs. Handle 429 rate limits with retries and backoff; inspect error.type and request_id for debugging.

title: Snapshot
fulltext_text: Create a response with model, input, and optional tools. Streaming returns incremental events. Errors include type=rate_limit_exceeded and a request_id header for tracing.

title: 12-factor for MCP services
note_html: Keep sync creds in env/config, emit structured logs, treat backing store as attached resource. Separate admin jobs (reindex) from request path.

title: BERT: Pre-training of Deep Bidirectional Transformers for Language Understanding
abstract_note: Introduces BERT with masked language modeling and next sentence prediction for transfer learning.

data.title: BERT: Pre-training of Deep Bidirectional Transformers for Language Understanding

fulltext_text: We introduce BERT, a deep bidirectional Transformer pre-trained on unlabeled text with masked LM. Fine-tuning achieves strong results on QA and GLUE benchmarks with minimal architecture changes.

title: NIST Special Publication 800-63B: Digital Identity Guidelines — Authentication and Lifecycle Management
publication_title: National Institute of Standards and Technology
abstract_note: Guidance on authenticators, enrollment, phishing resistance, and session management.

data.title: NIST Special Publication 800-63B: Digital Identity Guidelines — Authentication and Lifecycle Management

fulltext_text: NIST 800-63B defines assurance levels and recommends phishing-resistant authenticators. It covers enrollment, binding, reauthentication, session timeouts, and requirements for memorized secrets.

title: PDF
fulltext_text: This guideline specifies authenticator requirements, including AAL levels, verifier impersonation resistance, and session binding. It includes requirements for password length, rate limiting, and MFA.

title: Auth policy checklist
note_html: Require MFA for admin, prefer WebAuthn for phishing resistance. Enforce rate limits on OTP/password attempts. Short session TTL + reauth for sensitive actions.

title: Snowflake: A Scalable Data Warehouse on Top of AWS
abstract_note: Describes Snowflake’s architecture separating storage and compute with elastic scaling and strong isolation.

data.title: Snowflake: A Scalable Data Warehouse on Top of AWS

fulltext_text: Snowflake separates persistent storage from compute clusters, enabling elastic scaling and multi-tenant isolation. It supports semi-structured data and offers strong concurrency with minimal tuning.

title: SQLite Query Planner: How It Works
abstract_note: Explains SQLite’s query planner, indexes, and how to read EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN output.

data.title: SQLite Query Planner: How It Works

fulltext_text: SQLite picks plans based on estimated costs using available indexes. EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN helps diagnose full table scans and missing indexes. ANALYZE improves statistics for better choices.

title: EXPLAIN tips
note_html: When you see SCAN TABLE, check missing index or unselective predicate. Run ANALYZE after large imports.
